stem.text: A triglyceride consists of glycerol and three different fatty acids, linoleic acid (L), oleic acid (O) and palmitic acid (P).
The diagram shows one possible arrangement of the fatty acids L, O and P in the molecule.

stem.alt: Bracket labelled glycerol joined to three lines labelled L, O and P, in that order from top to bottom.

stem.text: What is the total number of different arrangements of the fatty acids in this triglyceride?
